description: Compare CPU, memory, GPU, network and disk load of all your bb machines on one shared timeline, with up to 7 days of history. Each machine gets a card with load average, swap, disk usage, disk IO, CPU temperature and every GPU, including Intel integrated graphics and Apple silicon, read without root. Agents check load before a heavy job with bb machine-load --json. A sidebar badge appears when any machine passes 80% CPU or RAM. Apple silicon temperature and power need macmon, installed separately.
